title: Product Experience Survey
description: Help us improve the product. This survey takes around 3 to 4 minutes.

questions.prompt: Which option best describes your role?
How satisfied are you with the overall survey portal experience?
Which parts of the product do you use most often?
What is your favorite part of the current experience?
What is the biggest pain point you face right now?
questions.placeholder: Share the biggest issue you are facing...

questions.prompt: If we could add one feature next, what should it be?
